mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCalls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatencyMs, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS totalCostAmount FROM ai_call_log

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS totalCostAmount FROM ai_call_log WHERE created_at >= #{periodStart} AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR user_id = #{userId}) AND (#{capabilityCode} IS NULL OR capability_code = #{capabilityCode}) AND (#{sceneCode} IS NULL OR scene_code = #{sceneCode})

SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS totalCostAmount FROM ai_call_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY bucket DESC

SELECT provider_code AS providerCode, model_code AS modelCode, COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS totalCostAmount, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatencyMs FROM ai_call_log GROUP BY provider_code, model_code ORDER BY totalCostAmount DESC, totalTokens DESC, totalCalls DESC LIMIT #{limit}
